source.source_name: GitHub Changelog: Actions workflow dependency lockfiles public preview
source.purpose: Assess free, reviewable commit-pinning alternative for repository GitHub Actions dependencies
source.cost_quota: free public documentation; preview available on Free plan; no API key used
source.reliability_limits: Preview availability and per-repository enablement not verified. Locking freezes reviewed references but cannot establish dependency trustworthiness; do not enable or change workflows without testing.

learning.title: Review GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles before relying on movable action tags
learning.claim: GitHub announced on 14 October 2026 that Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are in public preview on Free, Team and Enterprise Cloud plans; a reviewed actions.lock can bind onboarded workflows to recorded action, transitive action and reusable workflow commit SHAs even when tags or branches move. Locking does not establish that a dependency is trustworthy.
learning.decision: ACTIONS_DEPENDENCY_LOCKFILE_REVIEW_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. The current main tree has no .github/workflows/actions.lock. Inventory the actions/reusable-workflow dependencies, assess GitHub Actions lockfile preview eligibility, and use a non-mutating freshness check before any small pilot. Do not treat an untested preview as deployed protection or replace existing CI checks; require human review of pinned code and preserve working append-only workflows.
learning.next_measurement: Check a disposable PR/branch for lockfile preview support and a non-mutating lockfile freshness check; record exact head SHA, CI result, any permission/preview gate, and whether a real system report applies this learning. No production rollout without tested compatibility.
fallback_history: If preview is unavailable or changes risk the append-only workflows, retain current checks and evaluate commit-SHA pinning manually in a separate safe PR.
